reasons.glass_damage_covered: A cracked windshield is glass damage and the policy is stated to cover glass damage, so P(true) is very high with only minor scope-interpretation uncertainty.
reasons.handling_mode: No user instructions exist to supply an objective, so I default to the most useful bounded output: a final pay or do-not-pay answer is feasible here because coverage, evidence, and excess are all in the state; scoring remains plausible and adjuster routing is overkill for a small routine claim.
reasons.claim_complexity: Settlement is straightforward (clear covered peril, photo and quote on file, fixed 100 EUR excess), but some routine verification of the quote keeps most mass at the middle level.
